I want to build a habit tracking app where users can create custom habits, set reminders,
and view streak statistics. Users should be able to share their streaks with friends
and compete in weekly challenges.

Key features:
- Custom habit creation with frequency (daily/weekly/monthly)
- Push reminders
- Streak tracking with visual calendar
- Friend system with leaderboards
- Optional: AI-generated habit suggestions

I'm a solo developer with React and Node.js experience. I want to validate the idea
with a simple MVP before investing in a full build.
